name: 2am Gameworks
bio: 2am Gameworks is the studio of Australian designer Joel Finch, creator of Unfair, the theme-park building card game released in 2017, and its ABDW and CHKO expansions. The studio publishes the complete game, both expansions and the Quinn solo mode as free print-and-play files for personal use, alongside a scoring web app, rulebooks and card references.
